svg.title: 12M CDP, 2M actions online learning: scores versus actions and wall time
svg.desc: Last-50 completed episode means, not frozen competence. Partial groups show individual learner seeds; complete three-seed groups show means and 95% bootstrap bands. No extrapolation beyond measured support. Missing scores are not zero.

Last-50 episode mean. Dashed: individual learner seed. Solid + band: three-seed mean and 95% bootstrap CI.
